evals.prompt: The build fails with 'zmk,keymap not found'. What should I check?
evals.expected_output: Lists the keymap file path and the compatible property (zmk,keymap) as the first checks. Cites zmk/docs/docs/troubleshooting/building-issues.md. Uses read-only evidence (Read or Grep) and ranks hypotheses. Asks the owner to run any build and send back the output.
